枚举类 Desktop.Action

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Desktop.Action>
java.awt.Desktop.Action
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable, Comparable<Desktop.Action>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Desktop
public static enum Desktop.Action extends Enum<Desktop.Action>
Represents an action type. Each platform supports a different set of actions. You may use the Desktop.isSupported(Desktop.Action) method to determine if the given action is supported by the current platform.
自:
1.6
另见:
  • Desktop.isSupported(java.awt.Desktop.Action)
